clue.text: Black girl between two pairs in popular dance

indicators.note: something placed between two others sits inside them, so the first part goes in the middle of the second

explanation.walkthrough: Pairs are not couples here: in cricket a pair is a batsman's two ducks, nought in each innings, so each pair is two zeros.
explanation.definitionFit: The boogaloo is a 1960s dance style, popular in its day with rhythm-and-blues music.
